### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template: `DATA_ROOT` is the results directory given to `depictio ingest`, the others are set with `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of one raredisease run (alignment/, call_snv/, rank_and_filter/, qc_bam/, pedigree/, pipeline_info/). |
| `GENOME` | — | UCSC name of the assembly the run was aligned to (hg19 for GRCh37, hg38 for GRCh38): the axis of the Locus tab and the gene track of the browser. |
| `TRACKS_URI` | — | s3:// or https:// folder holding the run's results (the one that holds alignment/, rank_and_filter/ and qc_bam/), to read the genome-browser tracks (the ranked VCFs and the alignments) in place instead of uploading them from DATA_ROOT. Without it the `tracks` collection uploads whichever of those files DATA_ROOT holds. |

### Conditional routes

Rows are data collections; columns are the variables you set or `params.json` flags auto-detected from the run. Each filled cell is the effect of **setting** that variable; an **empty cell** means that variable leaves the collection unchanged. (16 collections are unaffected by any variable — present on every run.)

### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `OUTPUT_SCHEMA` columns.

|---|---|---|
